title: The Secret
description:
In the hidden city of Numeria, an old machine stands behind a locked chamber. Whenever a number is entered into the machine, it responds with a single number of its own. The people who built it left no instructions, and nobody knows what happens inside.

The rule behind its response is hidden. Study the examples carefully, uncover what the machine is doing, and reproduce its answer for any given number.
input_format: The input contains a single positive integer N.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the value produced by the system.
